overall_comments: Strong Round 2 retrofit. Trap is named in research-grounded terms (counting-marks vs counting-intervals; Lehrer 2003; Stephan & Cobb 2003) with three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: counts marks not intervals; B: starts at 1; C: non-zero start without subtraction). Roo's quotable refrain 'COUNT the SPACES, start at ZERO, end at the EDGE!' is introduced in minds_on and chanted 3x at exit. Action step 6 adds an explicit STRATEGY COMPARE (0-start vs non-zero-start) anchored to Stephan & Cobb's interval-counting principle. Materials are everyday with puppets explicitly OPTIONAL and a tape-on-floor body alternative for movement learners. Worksheet's three parts (measure, draw, error-spot) each practise a named success criterion and Part 3 transfers via novel error-spot diagrams. Cross-references Lesson 2 (cm intro) and previews Lessons 4-5.
